documents.name: Neta Barzilai Background
documents.source: Neta Barzilai is the Israeli singer who won the Eurovision Song Contest 2018 in Lisbon, Portugal with her fierce anthem 'TOY'. The win brought Eurovision 2019 to Tel Aviv. Her performance was celebrated for its bold, feminist message and unconventional staging featuring chicken sounds and powerful choreography. 'TOY' became a global LGBTQ+ anthem and pride anthem. Neta is known for her colorful, eccentric fashion and refusal to conform to conventional pop star standards. She is a vocal advocate for LGBTQ+ rights and self-expression. Born in Hod HaSharon, she studied at the Rimon School of Music. Neta has continued to release music after Eurovision including the album 'Rola'. She is a beloved figure at Pride events around the world. Her fanbase is passionate and international. Neta represents boldness, authenticity, and the power of being unapologetically yourself. She is known for her loop pedal technique during live performances. Her victory is considered one of the most memorable in recent Eurovision history. Neta continues to be an active performer and cultural figure in Israel and internationally.
